name: Eight-Angle Pose
description: Arm balance with the legs crossed and extended to one side of the bent arms.

source.title: Yoga Journal Pose Library
source.note: Stick-figure approximation. Twists and binds can't be fully shown in 2D.

setup: Sit with your legs out in front and lift one leg over the same-side upper arm, high toward the shoulder.
Plant your hands beside your hips, shoulder-width apart.

keyframes.name: Sit in Staff Pose
keyframes.cue: Sit tall with the legs straight out in front.

keyframes.name: Eight-Angle Pose
keyframes.cue: Hook the legs over one arm, lean forward, and lift.

cues: Squeeze the legs around the arm.
Lean forward to lift the hips.
